ns2:course.label: Modern Italian Novel
ns2:course.description: Appreciation of the modern Italian novel through a close reading of some representative works (e.g., Verga, Moravia, Vittorini, Pavese). 3 undergraduate hours. 3 graduate hours. Prerequisite: ITAL 200 or consent of instructor.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: 3 undergraduate hours. 3 graduate hours. Prerequisite: ITAL 200 or consent of instructor.
